title: Pure projection upcaster engine
description: Objective: a dependency-free, side-effect-free engine that upcasts stored events to their current domain schema version and folds them into projection state. SPIDR step 2 of 5, split from task-55d5a898264b4880a99bf2c5b3be120b. Deliverable: pure functions over in-memory values — no SQLite, no transactions, no I/O — so the fold is exhaustively testable without a database. Upcasters dispatch on the StoredEvent domain schema version added in step 1; an unknown or future version fails closed with a stable reason code and never silently passes the event through unmodified. NOT in scope: persistence, the relay/inbox transaction, subscriptions, CURSOR_GAP, or any SQLite access. Hard dependencies: Versioned event schema and projection commit seam (step 1) — needs the StoredEvent schema-version field to dispatch on. Owned paths: packages/store/src/projections/** and its focused tests. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test.
definitionOfDone: Upcasting and projection folding are pure functions over in-memory values with no SQLite, transaction, clock, or filesystem access, demonstrated by tests that construct no database.
An unknown or future domain schema version fails closed with a stable reason code; no event is silently passed through unmodified or dropped.
Folding the same event sequence twice yields identical frozen state, and out-of-order or duplicate input is rejected rather than absorbed.
The focused store typecheck and test command exits 0 and only explicitly owned paths are staged and committed.
taskRails: Purity is the deliverable. Any SQLite handle, transaction, clock read, or filesystem call in this subtree defeats the reason this step was split out.
Fail closed with stable reason codes on unknown versions; missing or unverifiable input stays UNKNOWN and never gains authority.
Use TDD. Keep each production source focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400. Commit by explicit pathspec only.

implementationPlan.description: Baseline (read-only): landed child surface verified — packages/store/src/projections/projection-upcast.ts exports UpcastPatch/UpcastHandler/UpcastRoute/UpcastDefinition, UpcastFailureCode incl. SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED, UpcastOutcome, StoredEventUpcaster {upcast(event: StoredEvent): UpcastOutcome}, compileStoredEventUpcaster (commit landed at HEAD). ADOPT the sibling architect's pinned fold contract VERBATIM (comment-70c6d93f + the CORRECTION comment-0da58bdf): this task owns EXACTLY projection-fold.ts / .js bridge / .test.ts; per-aggregate sequence is STRICTLY increasing within the supplied batch — EQUAL sequence = duplicate, LOWER = out-of-order, NO contiguity requirement and NO sequence-1 requirement (incremental pages/checkpoints start midstream). Fresh `pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test` GREEN baseline (shared tree — attribute foreign red by path).

TDD red — packages/store/src/projections/projection-fold.test.ts (<=250 physical; NO database construction anywhere — purity is the deliverable; assert-the-reason-code rail with mutation red-checks named per refusal). Cases: (1) HAPPY FOLD: foldProjection({checkpoint, state, events, upcaster, reducers}) over in-memory StoredEvent values — returns frozen {checkpoint', state'} with recursive plain-data state (no class instances, no functions); same input twice -> deep-equal frozen results (determinism, fixed fixtures); (2) PREFLIGHT ORDERING (all refusals BEFORE any reducer runs — assert the offending reducer was never invoked via a call-recording reducer): batch globalPosition strictly increasing and above the supplied checkpoint (at-or-below checkpoint -> stale code; non-increasing within batch -> out-of-order code); eventId uniqueness within batch (dup -> duplicate code); per-aggregate sequence STRICTLY increasing within batch (equal -> DUPLICATE code, lower -> OUT_OF_ORDER code — the correction's exact semantics; midstream start LEGAL: a batch beginning at sequence 7 with no prior context passes preflight); (3) UPCAST DISPATCH: every event runs through the supplied StoredEventUpcaster BEFORE its reducer; an unknown/future domainSchemaVersion surfaces the child's SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED outcome as a fold failure (layer-tagged: upcast layer, not fold layer) — the event is NEVER silently passed through unmodified (mutation red-check: bypass the upcaster in a scratch copy, the version test must go red) and NEVER dropped (failure aborts the fold); (4) NO PARTIAL STATE: a reducer throw or upcast failure mid-batch returns a frozen failure carrying the UNCHANGED input state + checkpoint (deep-equal to inputs; nothing folded from the failing batch survives); (5) reducer results deep-frozen + detached (mutating a reducer's returned object post-fold does not alter engine state); (6) hostile inputs (proxy/accessor/extra-key events) refused at preflight with the input-layer code. Confirm RED via `pnpm exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/store/src/projections/projection-fold.test.ts`.

Green — packages/store/src/projections/projection-fold.ts (target ~155 lines per the sibling sizing, <=250 HARD) + projection-fold.js (exactly `export * from "./projection-fold.ts";` — store subtree keeps committed bridges). Pure function shape: foldProjection(input: {checkpoint: {globalPosition: bigint|string per StoredEvent convention}, state: PlainProjectionState, events: readonly StoredEvent[], upcaster: StoredEventUpcaster, reducers: Readonly<Record<eventType, ProjectionReducer>>}) -> frozen {ok:true, checkpoint, state} | {ok:false, code, detail, checkpoint: input, state: input}; preflight pass FIRST over the whole batch (ordering/uniqueness/sequence rules), then per-event upcast->reduce with fail-closed abort; fold-layer issue codes as frozen local union (PROJECTION_FOLD_* — distinct from the upcast layer's codes so the which-layer assertion holds); no imports beyond './projection-upcast.js', '../store-contracts.js' (StoredEvent type), and store-internals validation helpers if needed — ZERO node: imports (no sqlite/fs/crypto/clock — purity rail; grep-enforced); no Date/random. All step-2 tests green; typecheck green.

Verification gate + adversarial self-review + commit. (1) `wc -l` both TS files <=250; bridge one line. (2) Fresh `pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test` -> exit 0 — complete_task evidence verbatim (the DoD names the full store gate, not just the focused file); attribute foreign red by path (projection siblings may be in flight). (3) PURITY GREP (the rail's teeth): `grep -n "node:\|DatabaseSync\|readFile\|writeFile\|Date\.\|Math\.random" packages/store/src/projections/projection-fold.ts` -> ZERO hits; test file constructs NO database (grep DatabaseSync in the test -> zero). (4) MUTATION RED-CHECKS (scratch copy OUTSIDE the repo): bypass upcaster -> version test red; skip preflight -> out-of-order test red; let a partial batch commit -> no-partial-state test red; unfreeze the result -> detachment test red. (5) Ordering red-team: craft a batch that is globalPosition-ordered but per-aggregate out-of-order (interleaved aggregates) — must refuse with the aggregate-layer code; equal-sequence duplicate across DIFFERENT eventIds -> duplicate code (the correction's exact case). (6) No scratch files (auto-commit sweep). Commit per epic rail 3: `git status --porcelain`, unstage foreign paths, `git add` + `git commit -- packages/store/src/projections/projection-fold.ts packages/store/src/projections/projection-fold.js packages/store/src/projections/projection-fold.test.ts`; `git show --stat` lists exactly these 3 paths.

After it lands, this parent becomes the pure fold/order consumer and should own exactly projection-fold.ts/.js/.test.ts (<=155/1/235): explicit checkpoint + recursive plain-data state, preflight strict globalPosition/unique eventId/per-aggregate nondecreasing sequence, call the child upcaster, reject duplicate/out-of-order before the offending reducer, return no partial state on reducer/upcast failure, and prove same-input deep-frozen determinism with fixed seeds. Do not require contiguity or sequence 1 because incremental pages/checkpoints may start midstream.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Direct plan: the sibling architect (c4babdf9) already made the SPIDR sizing decision and pinned the fold contract in two task comments (adopted verbatim, incl. the strictly-increasing-per-aggregate CORRECTION: equal=duplicate, lower=out-of-order, no contiguity/sequence-1 requirement — midstream pages legal), and the child upcaster landed with its real API (StoredEventUpcaster/UpcastOutcome/SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED verified on-screen). Design choices within the pins: (1) preflight-first over the WHOLE batch before any reducer runs — the call-recording-reducer assertion proves refusals precede reduction (assert-which-layer rail); (2) failure returns the UNCHANGED input state+checkpoint (no partial state — the task rail's exact demand; carrying a partially-folded state in the failure would be laundering); (3) fold-layer codes distinct from upcast-layer codes (PROJECTION_FOLD_* vs the child's UpcastFailureCode) so which-layer is assertable; (4) reducers as a caller-supplied Record keyed by eventType — the engine owns dispatch mechanics only, projection SEMANTICS stay with the relay/consumer tasks (SPIDR steps 3-5); (5) zero node: imports — purity grep is the gate's teeth.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Landed child (verified): projection-upcast.ts exports UpcastPatch/Handler/Route/Definition, UpcastFailureCode + SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED, UpcastOutcome, StoredEventUpcaster.upcast(event), compileStoredEventUpcaster — the fold calls upcast() per event and treats its failure outcomes as fold-aborting, layer-tagged failures. StoredEvent carries domainSchemaVersion (Task B1 landed) — dispatch is real. Store subtree keeps committed .js bridges (existing projection-upcast.js precedent). NEW epic rails: per-file cap only; assert-the-reason-code with mutation red-checks (encoded per refusal). The relay (071173ab), cursors (7617c00d), and crash/rebuild (791d7340) tasks consume this engine — keep the input shape minimal and caller-supplied (checkpoint/state/events/upcaster/reducers) so the relay wires the seam without engine changes.
planningNotes.risks: (1) Partial-state laundering on mid-batch failure is the conservation hazard — unchanged-input-echo asserted deep-equal + mutation red-check. (2) Silent pass-through on unknown versions defeats the whole upcaster split — bypass red-check mandatory. (3) Ordering subtleties: globalPosition-ordered batches can still be per-aggregate out-of-order (interleaving) — dedicated red-team case; equal-sequence-different-eventId is the correction's exact duplicate case. (4) Purity regression via a convenience import — grep gate. (5) Shared tree: projection siblings may be in flight — three-path commit, by-path attribution.
